comparison.objective: Open a folding-table leg, slide a lock ring over its brace knee, and prove it under load; candidate iteratively sets damper response and relocks it.
comparison.physical_skill: Large hinged articulation and sleeve sliding versus recessed hex-key engagement, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and repeated control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Leg upright, ring 12 mm past knee, and survives a 6 N load; candidate requires two safe 0.85 J-plus stops, stroke/rebound limits, and witness-torque retention.
comparison.reason: This is the closest functional analogy because both lock a setting and test it, but table-brace deployment tests a binary structural latch; the candidate tests continuous adjustment inferred from dynamic response.
